### Identity KPIs (live) - not available from Azure Monitor Workbooks

Azure Monitor Workbooks cannot query Microsoft Graph. MFA registration state, Conditional Access policy definitions, PIM assignments, user consent settings and guest/external collaboration settings are only exposed through Graph.

Use the Entra admin center workbooks instead: **Conditional Access gap analyzer**, **Sign-ins using legacy authentication**, **Multifactor authentication gaps** (Entra ID > Monitoring & health > Workbooks), or export the Graph data on a schedule into a Log Analytics custom table and point a Logs tile at it. The Legacy authentication, MFA and Privileged role tiles below run live from SigninLogs / AuditLogs / AADRiskyUsers.
